Re-picking is inherent to each picker call (mirrors the web input-value reset intent).

L244-246 closing GlassPanel/return/brace map to the JSX close; named `export function VehiclePhotoUpload` preserved and a default export added (sibling-port precedent). {toast.node} rendered last inside the panel.

Browser-only summary (rule 7): URL.createObjectURL/revokeObjectURL -> native-safe createPreviewUrl/revokePreviewUrl (descriptor uri direct; blob: revoke only); /fileInputRef/drag-drop -> host-injected picker with an explicit unavailable toast + vehiclePhotoUploadCapabilities; -> RN Image. Remote medium-photo URLs from vehiclePhotoUrl are rendered via Image source uri exactly as the web (no auth-cookie forwarding on native — a runtime/auth caveat, not a behaviour change, since the web likewise carries no per-request auth header). No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components are imported.

Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) EXIT 0; `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint . --quiet) EXIT 0; `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (jest) EXIT 0. Prettier conventions (singleQuote, arrowParens=avoid, trailingComma=all, bracketSpacing=false) applied.
